literal: 'I will feign anger,' saying to myself I went; I embraced him, seeing my heart desiring to unite.
translation: I went with the resolve to feign anger, but I ended up embracing him, seeing my own heart rushing to unite with him.
modern: நான் அவனிடம் ஊடல் கொள்ள வேண்டும் என்று நினைத்துச் சென்றேன்; ஆனால் என் நெஞ்சம் அவனுடன் கூடுவதற்கு விரைவதைக் கண்டு, அவனைத் தழுவிக்கொண்டேன்.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine describes how her resolve to remain angry melts away in her lover's presence. She approaches him intending to feign anger ('புலப்பல்') to test his love. However, upon seeing him, she realizes her own heart ('நெஞ்சம்') is already eager to unite ('கலத்தல் உறுவது') with him. Unable to resist her own heart's desire, she immediately embraces him ('புல்லினேன்'), showing that love triumphs over stubborn pride.
